name: dsh-org-talent
description: Organization-wide employee matching in the DSH left sidebar: editable current project requirements with pool sync; default team configuration with missing-role/skill prompts; compact project-alert matrix with count summaries and detailed drill-down; project progress/outcomes; product acceptance and duplicate guards; editable talent profiles and drag-to-team org chart; one best team with a base team; local SVG charts; one-paste feedback, memo, requirement pool, project conversations and capability advice. · 左侧栏的组织人才匹配：当前需求可编辑并同步需求池；默认团队配置显示角色与技能缺口；项目预警矩阵按项目×类型汇总并可下钻详情；项目进度/成果、产品验收与重复开发拦截；人才库编辑、组织架构拖拽调队；一组最佳团队与基础团队；本地数据图；粘贴反馈、备忘录、需求池、项目对话与培养建议。
